about_the_game:
Control Yourself is a puzzle platformer in a similar vein to games like Inside and Limbo. Our hero is a small robot tasked with answering distress calls in space.

A long forgotton craft from the first days of space exploration has been located.

Long since thought to have met an untimely end (on its mission to search for life in the far reaches of the cosmos) it appears like a celestial giant on the radar of the ISS Space Recovery And Rescue.

A solitary Joybot wakes from sleep and runs diagnostics as it awaits docking to begin its investigations.

Stepping aboard the place appears to be rundown with sign of damage to walkways and interior walls.

There is no sign of any crew but there are signs of different forms of life all around. A mould like substance grows amid the potted plants that still seem to flourish along the corridors.

You will have to use skills and cunning to make your way to the heart of the ship and uncover the truth that lies within.

And so begins the adventure, what mysteries will be uncovered as Joybot ventures aboard the vast and foreboding craft?

Most of the time you have found your standard setup of a pair of multiaxis arms with grabbing claws and the bipedal multi-terrain base works a treat.

Do you like unravelling mysteries, solving puzzles in ingenious ways and exploring strange space craft? If that sounds good then Control Yourself might be for you.

To keep up to date on all things Control Yourself don't forget to wishlist now.

short_description: Control Yourself is a single-player 3d puzzle platformer set aboard a recently returned but seemingly derelict old space craft. Solve fiendish puzzles, uncover secrets and upgrade your abilites to finally discover what fate has befallen this vast craft.
